title: Save a share of future raises
hook: Two stated cases: explore the savings allocation rule for future salary increases.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the savings allocation rule for future salary increases affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines SavedRate, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the savings allocation rule for future salary increases in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: Toy salary 100 grows by 0.05 each year for 4 years. Initial savings are fraction 0.035 of initial salary; fraction 0.5 of all raises is added to annual saving. What is the final saving rate?
claims.source: src/demos/behavioral/be-source-0321/model.ts; finite explicit model from tools/continuation/behavioral-3.tsv; source idea 500-behavioral-economics-findings.md #321. Empirical source remains unverified.
